decisions.reason: LHD loaders sit at the core of the firm's underground mining competence and draw on its established service base, and there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
Underground dump trucks complement the loader line, sharing customers, engineering and after-sales resources, so the firm's slack lets it keep carrying the line despite cyclical mining demand.

The construction site dumper is a smaller adjacent product with likely modest results, but it fits the firm's vehicle know-how and costs little to maintain in the range, so dropping it is not yet warranted.
Inclined furniture lifts serve a niche lifting market, and with stable demand from the post-2020 construction and moving activity, results likely meet the modest aspiration set for this line.
Inclined building material lifts benefited from strong German construction activity, so performance relative to aspiration likely gives no reason for search or withdrawal.
The truck-mounted furniture lift extends the lift family with shared components, and without signals of failure the firm would carry it within its existing lifting business.
